title: Three cases. One important distinction.

cases.title: Pothole in the tyre path
cases.reason: A visible pothole overlaps the left tyre corridor. The simulated pulse arrives at the expected crossing time.

cases.title: Pothole between the tyres
cases.reason: The pothole passes through the gap between the two tyres. No pulse is expected; no shock does not mean no pothole.

cases.title: Shadow + unrelated camera shake
cases.reason: The road mark is a simulated shadow, and the camera shake has an unrelated scripted cause. A jolt alone cannot confirm a pothole.

provenance: Original procedural illustration generated by tools/generate_demo.py. Scripted ground truth, boxes, corridors and motion. Not detector output, measured IMU or trained-model validation.
